name: xllm
description: Cross-vendor LLM advisors for Codex: ask claude, gemini, grok, cursor, or local ollama/lmstudio from inside a session and synthesize their independent opinions. Read-only by default.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-vendor LLM second opinions, read-only by default
interface.longDescription: Ask other vendors' CLIs (claude, gemini, grok, cursor) or local models (ollama, lmstudio) for independent opinions without leaving your session, then synthesize agreements and disagreements. Advisors run read-only by default and same-vendor nesting is refused.
